theorem_or_source_locator: Section 1, Lemma 15, p.12 (weighted prime-ideal sum); Lemma 14 and proof, pp.11–12 (smoothed sum). Character conventions and principal indicator p.2; explicit uniformity paragraph immediately before Lemma14 p.11.
conventions: Normalized ideal norm; Lambda_K(p^j)=log Np for j>=1; finite-order ray characters extended by zero at excluded primes; all residue degrees included; principal means induced by the trivial primitive character. Fixed field and logarithmic exponent. Constants ineffective.
objects_and_maps: E=Q(i); fixed finite-order ray character chi of modulus m; rational Dirichlet rho modulo q; theta(a)=chi(a)rho(Na), a ray character modulo m(q), whose finite modulus norm is at most Nm*q^2.
hypotheses_and_discharge: For q<=(log X)^B and sqrtX<=Y<=X, Nm*q^2<=(log Y)^(2B+1) for sufficiently large X depending only on m,B. Mitsui applies with fixed K=E and A=2B+1, uniformly over rho,q. SmallY<sqrtX handled by elementary ideal von Mangoldt sum bound. Fixed bounded X absorbed. Principal indicator checked by inducing character.
translation: Subtract the smoothed prime sums at x*exp(h) and x to prove unsmoothing for complex characters; bound prime powers of exponent>=2 by O_E(sqrtY log^2(2Y)); replace error atY by Xexp(-c sqrtlogX). Optional primitive-to-imprimitive restoration costs O_chi(log(q+2)log(Y+2)). Any fixed log-power saving follows. No extra Fogels external application is consumed by this proof.

theorem_or_source_locator: Section 1, Lemma 15, p.12 (weighted prime-ideal sum); Lemma 14 and proof, pp.11–12 (smoothed sum). Character conventions and principal indicator p.2; explicit uniformity paragraph immediately before Lemma14 p.11.
conventions: Normalized ideal norm; Lambda_K(p^j)=log Np for j>=1; finite-order ray characters extended by zero at excluded primes; all residue degrees included; principal means induced by the trivial primitive character. Fixed field and logarithmic exponent. Constants ineffective.
objects_and_maps: K=Q; Dirichlet character rho modulo q viewed as a ray character with finite modulus q and, for odd parity, the real infinite place.
hypotheses_and_discharge: Mitsui allows arbitrary fixed number field including Q and ray moduli containing infinite places. For q<=(log X)^B and sqrtX<=Y<=X use A=B+1; finite modulus norm is q. SmallY and boundedX handled elementarily. Principal character is exactly rho principal moduloq.
translation: Apply the same weighted-prime estimate over Q; restore rational prime powers with O(sqrtY log^2(2Y)); obtain uniform allY<=X and q<=log^B X with Xexp(-c_B sqrtlogX) error and its fixed log-power consequences.
